intro.heading: Everything your family needs, on site.
intro.body: We built White Cherry Cottages around the things our own families look for in a getaway: a real shul within walking distance, a mikvah on the property, a heated pool the kids will live in, and a freezer of kosher staples for the night you don't feel like cooking.

items.title: Heated Outdoor Pool
items.body: Open Memorial Day through Labor Day, heated to 84°F. Separate swim hours posted weekly. Lounge chairs, umbrellas, and a shallow end for the little ones.

items.title: Book Room
items.body: A quiet, light-filled library stocked with seforim, novels, kids' books, and board games. Open all day; help yourself.

items.title: Playground
items.body: Wooden play structure, swings, slide, and a sandbox — set in a fenced clearing visible from most of the cottages.

items.title: On-Site Shul
items.body: A small but proper shul on the property with daily minyanim during peak season. Walking distance from every cottage.

items.title: Mikvah
items.body: A clean, modern mikvah on the property, by appointment. A discreet entrance and a private parking spot.

items.title: Frozen Food Availability
items.body: A stocked freezer of kosher staples — challah, soups, kugels, pizza — available for purchase at the office. Perfect for the night you arrived late.

closing.heading: A Shabbos-friendly community in the White Mountains.
closing.body: Pre-arranged Shabbos meal delivery, hot-water urns and blechs in every cottage, key-card-free Shabbos entry, and a lobby of fellow families just like yours.
